name: Dark Folk
source:
A man marked by faith journeys through a world shaped by myths and ancient whispers.
What begins as a simple tale of devotion becomes a story of inner conflict and revelation.

[From [url=https://samfoxy.itch.io/dark-folk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个以信仰为标志的男人穿越了一个由神话和古老的低语塑造的世界。
一开始是一个简单的奉献故事，后来变成了一个关于内心冲突和启示的故事。

[来自[url=https://samfoxy.itch.io/dark-folk]Itch.io[/url]]
